messages.en: That was a hard-earned win, wasn't it?
It sure was! Good thing we didn't give up back there.

senses.en_definition: Later; after another person, time, or event.
At some future time; in the future.
Then; next in a sequence of actions or events.

messages.en: The bus leaves at eight, right? Have we got time to grab a bite before we leave?
Yeah. Let's eat first, then head to the bus station. It's just nearby.
I might be a bit late. Just go on in without me, okay?
Okay, I'm already at the café. I'll save you a seat.

senses.en_definition: To touch, come into contact with, collide with, or be struck by something.

collocations.en: come into contact with shards of glass

senses.en_definition: To hit the intended target, as a shot or thrown object.
To experience or be affected by something, especially an unpleasant event or illness.
Used before a verb to indicate being subjected to an action, usually an unwelcome one.
To be subject to a requirement, charge, or penalty.
Suitable, fitting, or appropriate to a person, situation, or purpose.
To have to do something; must.

messages.en: We've got to head off early tomorrow. We need to be out of the house by six.
That's so early! But yeah, you're right—the traffic will get bad later. I'll be ready before six.
